future_check: The Racket rule retains clipping as a total-function fallback, but no official input clips and the generator intentionally requires complete in-bounds stamps; self_check now enforces that declared generator invariant.; The no_markers blank-output case is explicit-only (n_markers=0 or texture=no_markers), never a normal default draw.; Palette {0,2,6} is intrinsic to the canonical rule; low color count is not a diversity defect.
rationale: VERSION 2.4.0 -> 2.5.0; added executable complete linked profile_signature and canonical signature set plus an independent Python rule_mirror; normalized explicit texture="none" to the omitted default and declared it in AXES; made decoy parsing strict: bool or exact true/false strings only; integers and other strings reject; made n_markers=0 honest in AXES and recorded forced n_markers/decoy outcomes on every texture path; made no_markers/no_decoy/packed_markers reject conflicting exact overrides instead of silently weakening the texture; restricted the canonical prior to truly default-only draws, including no explicit decoy override; self_check now rejects clipped marker stamps; marker placement and self_check now require an empty 8-neighborhood, removing unsupported merged multicolor input silhouettes; added nine focused regression groups covering all canonical pairs, contracts, provenance, clipping, marker separation, linked stability, negative recombination, determinism, fresh returns, and global RNG isolation
summary: Select the unique largest color-6 4-connected component, normalize its cells to the component bounding-box top-left, and stamp that exact shape in color 6 onto a blank same-size grid at every color-2 marker; the marker is the top-left anchor and rule-level out-of-bounds cells clip.
